mapper.select: SELECT FI.FTA_CODE AS ftaCode ,FI.DIVISION_CODE AS divisionCode ,FI.COMPANY_CODE AS companyCode ,FI.PRODUCT_CODE AS productCode ,FI.ITEM_CODE AS itemCode ,#{parentHsCode} AS parentHsCode ,FI.HS_CODE AS hsCode ,FI.STANDARD AS standard ,FI.WEIGHT AS weight ,FI.REQUIREMENT_QTY AS requirementQty ,FI.INPUT_AMOUNT AS inputAmount ,FI.INAREA_QTY AS originatingQty ,FI.INAREA_AMOUNT AS originatingAmount ,FI.OUTAREA_QTY AS nonOriginatingQty ,FI.OUTAREA_AMOUNT AS nonOriginatingAmount FROM FCR_DTL FI WHERE FI.FTA_CODE = #{ftaCode} AND FI.DIVISION_CODE = #{divisionCode} AND FI.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND FI.SALES_NO = #{salesNo} AND FI.SALES_SEQ = #{salesSeq}

SELECT RULE_ID AS ruleId ,FTA_CODE AS ftaCode ,HS_CODE AS hsCode ,HS_CODE_SUB_CATEGORY AS hsCodeSubCategory ,RULE_SEQ AS ruleSeq ,HS_CODE_DESCRIPTION AS hsCodeDescription ,RULE_DESCRIPTION AS ruleDescription ,RULE_CONTENTS AS ruleContents ,CASE WHEN POSITION('SP' IN RULE_CONTENTS) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE 'SP' END AS spRule ,COALESCE(WO_RULE, '*') AS woRule ,COALESCE(CTH_RULE, '*') AS cthRule ,COALESCE(BD_RULE, 0) AS bdRule ,COALESCE(BU_RULE, 0) AS buRule ,COALESCE(NC_RULE, 0) AS ncRule ,COALESCE(MC_RULE, 0) AS mcRule ,DE_MINIMIS_UNIT AS deMinimisUnit ,DE_MINIMIS_RATE AS deMinimisRate ,EXCLUSION_RULE_YN AS exclusionRuleYn FROM FTA_RULE ,(-- CTSH > CTH > CC 순으로 룰을 찾기 위해 적용가능한 HS_CODE 의 최대 길이를 구한다 SELECT MAX(LENGTH(HS_CODE)) AS HS_CODE_LENGTH FROM FTA_RULE WHERE HS_CODE = SUBSTRING(#{hsCode} FROM 1 FOR LENGTH(HS_CODE)) AND FTA_CODE = #{ftaCode} AND HS_CODE_SUB_CATEGORY = #{hsCodeSubCategory}) FRL WHERE HS_CODE = SUBSTRING(#{hsCode} FROM 1 FOR FRL.HS_CODE_LENGTH) AND FTA_CODE = #{ftaCode} AND HS_CODE_SUB_CATEGORY = #{hsCodeSubCategory}
AND RULE_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND (FTA_CODE <> 'PKRAP' OR #{newAptaPsrFlag} <> '0' OR RULE_SEQ = '1') ORDER BY RULE_SEQ
